title: Streaming execution drops spawn-time environment variables
reasoning: The streaming runtime stores env_vars but passes only the per-command env to get_full_env. Variables supplied during spawn therefore reach setup commands but disappear from subsequent commands. The equivalent exec runtime explicitly merges both sources, and its integration test establishes the intended precedence and preservation behavior.
reproduction: Spawn a streaming runtime with env_vars containing a unique variable, then stream a command that reads it with env={}. The configured value is absent.
recommendation: Merge self._env_vars with the per-command env before calling get_full_env, allowing per-command values to override spawn-time values.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Streaming tests only pass variables directly to stream(); the spawn/execute merging scenario exists only for LocalExecRuntime.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend streaming environment coverage to check preservation of spawn-only and command-only variables and command-level precedence for overlapping keys.
